purpose: Provide printed-page and hierarchy locators for primary content in the Ministry of Education Mathematics Curriculum Standards for Compulsory Education (2022 Edition), without fabricating per-bullet page numbers that have not been directly rendered.

pagination_method.note: The official government attachment is about 40 MB and cannot be rendered through the current web parser. Printed pagination was cross-checked against indexed page-numbered copies that match the Ministry document identity and table of contents. Claim-level locators therefore use the exact printed domain page/range plus hierarchy/stage/subsection/item, not an invented exact page for each bullet.
pagination_method.publication_rule: Display the Ministry as the authority. Do not cite a transcription/mirror as the policy authority.

integrity_rules: The printed page range is not equivalent to an exact page for every bullet.
Use the most specific hierarchy available after the printed range.
Do not turn a learning-stage requirement into an exact Chinese grade unless textbook evidence supplies the grade/semester placement.
Keep PEP textbook sequence locators separate from national curriculum locators.
When a teacher-facing claim needs verbatim page-level proof, retain exact_page_pending unless a directly rendered page is available.
